messages:
Maya: Hey team — re-requesting review on PR #4234. Addressed the serialization edge case Tom called out, added a small unit test and a CHANGELOG entry. Kept the old behavior behind a feature flag for now. PTAL when you have a minute: https://git.internal/repo/pull/4234 :pray:

Tom: looking now. did CI finish? any flaky tests left? :eyes:

Maya: CI passed on linux/mac, there was a windows flake in integration earlier but I reproduced it and fixed it in the last commit. Ran local e2e: `./scripts/e2e.sh --filter serialization` — all green locally. I also added a note under docs/upgrade.md about the migration step.

Rafi: nice. Two tiny suggestions: rename `test_serialize` -> `test_serialize_with_unicode` for clarity, and make the feature flag default off (safer). Also, can we check an env var at runtime so ops can toggle without redeploy? Otherwise looks good.

Maya: good catches. Changed the test name and flipped the flag default. Added an env override. Patch snippet:```diff
- const FEATURE_SERIALIZE_NEW = true;
+ const FEATURE_SERIALIZE_NEW = process.env.FEATURE_SERIALIZE_NEW === '1' || false;
```
Applied and pushed.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed — build 4821 succeeded (unit, integration, lint).

Tom: LGTM after the flag change. I'd like this squashed on merge so history stays tidy. @release-custodian can we slot this for tomorrow morning canary? :calendar:

release-custodian: I can take it tomorrow AM if it's rebased onto main. Please rebase and ping here.

Maya: rebased onto main and force-pushed `git push --force`. PTAL for final merge.

Tom: ACK, merging now. Thanks for the quick turnaround! :tada:

Maya: thanks all!
